breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction. The incomplete prompt specified a counterflow heat exchanger but provided the temperature differences for a parallel-flow configuration. The agent ignored the incorrect temperature differences and instead used the correct ones for a counterflow system (ΔT₁ = Th,in − Tc,out and ΔT₂ = Th,out − Tc,in), which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
